english.meaning: a way or method of doing something
english.note: Seen in 做法 (way of doing) and 講法 (way of saying).

exampleSentences.english: Huh? I’d still be screwed even if you didn’t make me pay the licensing fee! That’s how it’s done.
exampleSentences.traditional: 吓？你唔使我俾牌費我都死𠿪！即係噉樣做法係。
